name: plane-hunt
description: 絕對機密 Top Secret：尋機頭、海戰棋、幾A幾B 線上雙人對戰

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:firebase: concurrently -k -n emu,api,web -c yellow,blue,magenta "npx --yes firebase-tools@15 emulators:start --project demo-planehunt" "npm run dev:firebase -w server" "npm run dev:firebase -w web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
